name: exposes
description: The CLI command sends this command or asks this query.

name: implements
description: The generator file emits the code that keeps the contract.

name: keeps
description: The file holds the code that keeps the contract.

name: owes
description: The component renders the shared code this contract governs, although another component owns the contract.

name: proves
description: The test proves the library contract.

name: proves
description: The test proves its parent contract.

name: takes_over
description: The package holds the code the component's generator emitted the same way into every service; after the move the component emits only wiring and what varies with the declaration.
